english_qarai: As for man, whenever his Lord tests him, and grants him honour, and blesses him, he says, ‘My Lord has honoured me.’
urdu_jawadi: لیکن انسان کا حال یہ ہے کہ جب خدا نے اس کو اس طرح آزمایا کہ عزّت اور نعمت دے دی تو کہنے لگا کہ میرے رب نے مجھے باعزّت بنایا ہے
en_pickthall: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.
en_sahih: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
en_khattab: Now, whenever a human being is tested by their Lord through ˹His˺ generosity and blessings, they boast, “My Lord has ˹deservedly˺ honoured me!”
en_usmani: As for man, when his Lord tests him, and thus gives him honour and bounties, he says, “My Lord has honoured me.”
en_abdelhaleem: [The nature of] man is that, when his Lord tries him through honour and blessings, he says, ‘My Lord has honoured me,’
en_asad: BUT AS FOR man, whenever his Sustainer tries him by His generosity and by letting him enjoy a life of ease, he says, "My Sustainer has been [justly] generous towards me";
en_yusufali: Now, as for man, when his Lord trieth him, giving him honour and gifts, then saith he, (puffed up), "My Lord hath honoured me."
en_qarai: As for man, whenever his Lord tests him, and grants him honour, and blesses him, he says, ‘My Lord has honoured me.’
en_ahmedali: As for man, whenever his Lord tries him and then is gracious and provides good things for him, he says: "My Lord has been gracious to me."
en_maududi: As for man, when his Lord tests him by exalting him and bestowing His bounties upon him, he says: “My Lord has exalted me.”
en_hilali: As for man, when his Lord tries him by giving him honour and gifts, then he says (puffed up): "My Lord has honoured me."
en_ahmedraza: So man, whenever his Lord tests him by giving him honour and favours – thereupon he says, “My Lord has honoured me.”
en_wahiduddin: As for man, when his Lord tests him, through honour and blessings, he says, "My Lord has honoured me,"
en_arberry: As for man, whenever his Lord tries him, and honours him, and blesses him, then he says, 'My Lord has honoured me.'
en_daryabadi: As for man - when his Lord proveth him and so honoureth him and is bounteous Unto him, then he saith: 'my Lord hath honoured me,
en_itani: As for man, whenever his Lord tests him, and honors him, and prospers him, he says, “My Lord has honored me.”

en_sarwar: As for the human being, when his Lord tests him, honors him, and grants him bounty, he says, "God has honored me".
en_shakir: And as for man, when his Lord tries him, then treats him with honor and makes him lead an easy life, he says: My Lord honors me.
ur_jalandhry: مگر انسان (عجیب مخلوق ہے کہ) جب اس کا پروردگار اس کو آزماتا ہے تو اسے عزت دیتا اور نعمت بخشتا ہے۔ تو کہتا ہے کہ (آہا) میرے پروردگار نے مجھے عزت بخشی
ur_jawadi: لیکن انسان کا حال یہ ہے کہ جب خدا نے اس کو اس طرح آزمایا کہ عزّت اور نعمت دے دی تو کہنے لگا کہ میرے رب نے مجھے باعزّت بنایا ہے
ur_kanzuliman: لیکن آدمی تو جب اسے اس کا رب آزمائے کہ اس کو جاہ اور نعمت دے، جب تو کہتا ہے میرے رب نے مجھے عزت دی،
ur_maududi: مگر انسان کا حال یہ ہے کہ اس کا رب جب اُس کو آزمائش میں ڈالتا ہے اور اُسے عزت اور نعمت دیتا ہے تو وہ کہتا ہے کہ میرے رب نے مجھے عزت دار بنا دیا
ur_qadri: مگر انسان (ایسا ہے) کہ جب اس کا رب اسے (راحت و آسائش دے کر) آزماتا ہے اور اسے عزت سے نوازتا ہے اور اسے نعمتیں بخشتا ہے تو وہ کہتا ہے: میرے رب نے مجھ پر کرم فرمایا،
ur_junagarhi: انسان (کا یہ حال ہے کہ) جب اسے اس کا رب آزماتا ہے اور عزت ونعمت دیتا ہے تو وه کہنے لگتا ہے کہ میرے رب نے مجھے عزت دار بنایا
ur_ahmedali: لیکن انسان تو ایسا ہے کہ جب اسے اس کا رب آزماتا ہے پھر اسے عزت اور نعمت دیتا ہے تو کہتا ہے کہ میرے رب نے مجھے عزت بخشی ہے
ur_najafi: لیکن انسان (کا حال یہ ہے کہ) جب اس کا پروردگار اسے آزماتا ہے اور اسے عزت و نعمت دیتا ہے تو وہ کہتا ہے کہ میرے پروردگار نے میری عزت افزائی کی۔
fa_ayati: اما آدمى، چون پروردگارش بيازمايد و گرامى‌اش دارد و نعمتش دهد، مى‌گويد: پروردگار من مرا گرامى داشت
fa_bahrampour: اما آدمى را چون پروردگارش بيازمايد و او را گرامى داشته نعمتش دهد گويد: خدايم مرا گرامى داشت
fa_khorramshahi: اما انسان چون پروردگارش او را بیازماید و او را گرامی دارد و به او نعمت بخشد، [شاد و مغرور شود و] گوید پروردگارم مرا گرامی داشت‌
fa_ansarian: اما انسان، هنگامی که پروردگارش او را بیازماید و گرامی داردش و نعمتش بخشد، می گوید: پروردگارم [چون شایسته و سزاوار بودم] مرا گرامی داشت،
fa_gharaati: امّا انسان، هرگاه پروردگارش او را بیازماید و گرامیش دارد و نعمتش دهد، مى‌گوید: «پروردگارم مرا گرامى داشته است.»
fa_ghomshei: اما انسان (کم ظرف ضعیف بی صبر) چون خدا او را برای آزمایش و امتحان کرامت و نعمتی بخشد در آن حال (مغرور ناز و نعمت شود و) گوید: خدا مرا عزیز و گرامی داشت
fa_makarem: امّا انسان هنگامی که پروردگارش او را برای آزمایش، اکرام می‌کند و نعمت می‌بخشد (مغرور می‌شود و) می‌گوید: «پروردگارم مرا گرامی داشته است!»
fa_tehrani: پس اما انسان، هنگامی که پروردگارش وی را بیازماید و گرامیش بدارد، و نعمت به او دهد، گوید: «پروردگارم مرا گرامی داشته است.»
fa_mojtabavi: اما آدمى را چون پروردگارش بيازمايد و او را گرامى دارد و نعمتش دهد، گويد: پروردگارم مرا گرامى داشت- چون شايسته اين گراميداشت بودم
fa_khorramdel: امّا انسان (آن انسانی که در پرتو ایمان عقل و خردش رشد نیافته است، و شخص خود را مقیاس همه چیز می‌پندارد) همین که پروردگارش او را بیازماید و برای این کار او را بزرگی ببخشد و بدو نعمت بدهد، خواهد گفت: پروردگارم مرا بزرگوار و گرامی و محترم و مکرم دیده است! (و این عزّت و نعمت، حق من و شایسته‌ی من است)
de_aburida: Wenn aber der Mensch von seinem Herrn geprüft wird, indem Er ihm Wohltaten erweist und Gnaden auf ihn häuft, dann sagt er: "Mein Herr hat mich gewürdigt
de_bubenheim: Was nun den Menschen angeht, wenn sein Herr ihn prüft und ihn da(bei) freigebig behandelt und ihm ein wonnevolles Leben verschafft, so sagt er: Mein Herr behandelt mich freigebig
de_khoury: Aber der Mensch, wenn sein Herr ihn prüft und großzügig behandelt und ihm ein angenehmes Leben schenkt, sagt: «Mein Herr behandelt mich großzügig.»
de_zaidan: Also hinsichtlich des Menschen, wenn ER ihn prüft und ihm Würde und Wohltat erweist, so sagt er: "Mein HERR erwies mir Würde
ur_taqiusmani: لیکن انسان کا حال یہ ہے کہ جب اس کا پروردگار اسے آزماتا ہے اور انعام و اکرام سے نوازتا ہے تو وہ کہتا ہے کہ : میرے پروردگار نے میری عزت کی ہے۔
ur_karamshah: مگر انسان (بھی عجب شئے ہے ) کہ جب آزماتا ہے اسے اس کا رب یعنی اس کو عزت دیتا ہے اور پر انعام فرماتا ہے تو وہ کہتا ہے میرے رب نے مجھے عزت بخشی
ur_mahmudalhasan: سو آدمی جو ہے جب جانچے اُسکو رب اُس کا پھر اُس کو عزت دے اور اُسکو نعمت دے تو کہے میرے رب نے مجھ کو عزت دی 1
ur_zilalquran: اور جب وہ اس کو آزمائش میں ڈالتا ہے اور اس کا رزق اس پر تنگ کردیتا ہے تو وہ کہتا ہے میرے رب نے مجھے ذلیل کردیا “۔
ur_bayanulquran: انسان کا معاملہ یہ ہے کہ جب اس کا ربّ اسے آزماتا ہے پھر اسے عزت دیتا ہے اور نعمتیں عطا کرتا ہے تو وہ کہتا ہے میرے رب نے مجھے عزت دی !
ur_wahiduddin: پس انسان کا حال یہ ہے کہ جب اس کا رب اس کو آزماتا ہے اور اس کو عزت اور نعمت دیتا ہے تو وہ کہتا ہے کہ میرے رب نے مجھ کو عزت دی

english_qarai: But when He tests him and tightens for him his provision, he says, ‘My Lord has humiliated me.’
urdu_jawadi: اور جب آزمائش کے لئے روزی کو تنگ کردیا تو کہنے لگا کہ میرے پروردگار نے میری توہین کی ہے
en_pickthall: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.
en_sahih: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
en_khattab: But when He tests them by limiting their provision, they protest, “My Lord has ˹undeservedly˺ humiliated me!”
en_usmani: But when he tests him, and thus straitens his provision for him, he says, “My Lord has disgraced me.”
en_abdelhaleem: but when He tries him through the restriction of his provision, he says, ‘My Lord has humiliated me.’
en_asad: whereas, whenever He tries him by straitening his means of livelihood, he says, "My Sustainer has disgraced me!"
en_yusufali: But when He trieth him, restricting his subsistence for him, then saith he (in despair), "My Lord hath humiliated me!"
en_qarai: But when He tests him and tightens for him his provision, he says, ‘My Lord has humiliated me.’
en_ahmedali: But when He tries him by restraining his means, he says: "My Lord despises me."
en_maududi: But when He tests him by straitening his sustenance, he says: “My Lord has humiliated me.”
en_hilali: But when He tries him, by straitening his means of life, he says: "My Lord has humiliated me!"
en_ahmedraza: And if He tests him and restricts his livelihood – thereupon he says, “My Lord has degraded me!”
en_wahiduddin: but when He tests him by straitening his means of livelihood, he says, "My Lord has disgraced me."
en_arberry: But when he tries him and stints for him his provision, then he says, 'My Lord has despised me.'
en_daryabadi: And when He proveth him, and so stinteth Unto him his provision, he saith: 'my Lord hath despised me.
en_itani: But whenever He tests him, and restricts his livelihood for him, he says, “My Lord has insulted me.”
en_mubarakpuri: But when He tries him by straitening his means of life, he says: "My Lord has humiliated me!"
en_sarwar: However, when his Lord tests him by a measured amount of sustenance, he says, "God has disgraced me".
en_shakir: But when He tries him (differently), then straitens to him his means of subsistence, he says: My Lord has disgraced me.

ur_kanzuliman: اور اگر آزمائے اور اس کا رزق اس پر تنگ کرے، تو کہتا ہے میرے رب نے مجھے خوار کیا،

ur_qadri: لیکن جب وہ اسے (تکلیف و مصیبت دے کر) آزماتا ہے اور اس پر اس کا رزق تنگ کرتا ہے تو وہ کہتا ہے: میرے رب نے مجھے ذلیل کر دیا،
ur_junagarhi: اور جب وه اس کو آزماتا ہے اس کی روزی تنگ کر دیتا ہے تو وه کہنے لگتا ہے کہ میرے رب نے میری اہانت کی (اور ذلیل کیا)
ur_ahmedali: لیکن جب اسے آزماتا ہے پھر اس پر اس کی روزی تنگ کر تا ہے تو کہتا ہے میرے رب نے مجھے ذلیل کر دیا
ur_najafi: اور جب وہ (خدا) اسے اس طرح آزماتا ہے کہ اس کا رزق اس پر تنگ کر دیتا ہے تو وہ کہتا ہے کہ میرے پروردگار نے مجھے ذلیل کر دیا۔
fa_ayati: و چون بيازمايدش و رزق بر او تنگ گيرد، مى‌گويد: پروردگار من مرا خوار ساخت
fa_bahrampour: و اما چون او را بيازمايد و روزيش را تنگ سازد پس گويد: پروردگارم مرا خوار كرد
fa_khorramshahi: و اما چون او را [به بلا و محنت‌] بیازماید و روزی او را بر او تنگ گیرد، [بی‌صبری و ناسپاسی کند و] گوید پروردگارم مرا خوار داشت‌
fa_ansarian: و اما چون او را بیازماید، پس روزی اش را بر او تنگ گیرد، گوید: پروردگارم مرا خوار و زبون کرد
fa_gharaati: ولى هرگاه او را بیازماید و روزى او را تنگ سازد، مى‌گوید: «پروردگارم مرا خوار کرده است.»
fa_ghomshei: و چون او را باز برای آزمودن تنگ روزی کند (دلتنگ و غمین شود و) گوید: خدا مرا خوار گردانید
fa_makarem: و امّا هنگامی که برای امتحان، روزیش را بر او تنگ می‌گیرد (مأیوس می‌شود و) می‌گوید: «پروردگارم مرا خوار کرده است!»
fa_tehrani: و اما هنگامی که بیازمایدش، پس روزی‌اش را بر او تنگ گرداند، گوید: «پروردگارم به من اهانت کرده است.»
fa_mojtabavi: و اما چون او را بيازمايد و روزى‌اش را بر او تنگ سازد، گويد: پروردگارم مرا خوار و زبون كرد- به سبب اين ابتلا
fa_khorramdel: و امّا زمانی که پروردگارش او را بیازماید و برای این کار روزی او را تنگ و کم نماید، خواهد گفت: پروردگارم مراخوار و زبون داشته است (و با فقر و فاقه، ذلیل و حقیرم نموده است)
de_aburida: Wenn Er ihn aber prüft, indem Er ihm seine Versorgung verkürzt, dann sagt er: "Mein Herr hat mich erniedrigt
de_bubenheim: Was (ihn) aber angeht, wenn Er ihn prüft und ihm da(bei) seine Versorgung bemißt, so sagt er: Mein Herr setzt mich der Schmach aus
de_khoury: Wenn Er ihn aber prüft und ihm seinen Lebensunterhalt bemessen zuteilt, sagt er: «Mein Herr läßt mich Schmach erleiden.»

english_qarai: the day when hell is brought [near], man will take admonition on that day, but what will that admonition avail him

en_pickthall: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)?
en_sahih: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
en_khattab: and Hell is brought forth on that Day—this is when every ˹disbelieving˺ person will remember ˹their own sins˺. But what is the use of remembering then
en_usmani: and Jahannam (Hell), on that day, will be brought forward, it will be the day when man will realize the truth, but from where will he take advantage of such realization?
en_abdelhaleem: when Hell is that Day brought near- on that Day man will take heed, but what good will that be to him then?
en_asad: And on that Day hell will be brought [within sight]; on that Day man will remember [all that he did and failed to do]: but what will that remembrance avail him?
en_yusufali: And Hell, that Day, is brought (face to face),- on that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance profit him?
en_qarai: the day when hell is brought [near], man will take admonition on that day, but what will that admonition avail him?
en_ahmedali: And Hell is brought near, that day will man remember, but of what avail will then remembering be?
en_maududi: and when Hell is brought near that Day. On that Day will man understand, but of what avail will that understanding be?
en_hilali: And Hell will be brought near that Day. On that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance (then) avail him?
en_ahmedraza: And when hell is brought that day – on that day will man reflect, but where is the time now to think?
en_wahiduddin: and Hell is made to appear on that Day, then man will be mindful, but what will being mindful then avail him?
en_arberry: and Gehenna is brought out, upon that day man will remember; and how shall the Reminder be for him?
en_daryabadi: And the Hell on that Day shall be brought nigh. On that Day man shall remember, but how will remembrance avail him?
en_itani: And on that Day, Hell is brought forward. On that Day, man will remember, but how will remembrance avail him?
en_mubarakpuri: And Hell will be brought near that Day. On that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance avail him
en_sarwar: On that day, hell will be brought closer and the human being will come to his senses, but this will be of no avail to him.
en_shakir: And hell is made to appear on that day. On that day shall man be mindful, and what shall being mindful (then) avail him?

ur_jawadi: اور جہنمّ کو اس دن سامنے لایا جائے گا تو انسان کو ہوش آجائے گا لیکن اس دن ہوش آنے کا کیا فائدہ

ur_najafi: اور اس دن جہنم (سامنے) لائی جائے گی اور اس دن انسان کو سمجھ آئے گی مگر اب سمجھ آنے کا کیا فائدہ؟
fa_ayati: و در آن روز جهنم را حاضر آرند، آدمى پند گيرد. و چه جاى پند گرفتن باشد؟
